judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test-writing/planning phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the bug. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is untouched, the new test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` scratch file. Finally, rather than adding the test to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` with a rejecting provider as requested by the acceptance criteria ('A provider rejecting with a string...'), the candidate created a separate test file that rejects from a `beforeModelResponse` hook instead.
